01.name: The Creative
01.description: A white-robed dragon heir standing on the ridge of a cloud palace as golden qi spirals upward into a vast starry sky, immortal mountains opening like a gate of pure potential, heroic upward energy.

02.name: The Receptive
02.description: An earth-aligned immortal woman kneeling in a fertile moonlit valley beneath broad lotus leaves and terraced fields, jade dew glowing on stones and roots, patient yielding strength, devotion, and receptive earth power.

03.name: Difficulty at the Beginning
03.description: A young sect disciple pushing through storm-tangled reeds beside a flooded mountain path, boots on wet stones, distant academy lanterns glowing through blue mist, fragile beginnings meeting chaos with courage.

04.name: Youthful Folly
04.description: A curious apprentice cultivator kneeling beside a clear mountain spring outside an immortal academy gate, their reflection rippling with pale moonlight and floating peach petals, innocence waiting to be taught by stillness.

05.name: Waiting
05.description: A patient sword cultivator sitting beneath a pavilion eave while silver rain threads down into a lotus pond, a covered tea bowl steaming beside an unsheathed but untouched flying sword, clouds slowly parting beyond the courtyard, trust in timing.

06.name: Conflict
06.description: Two rival sect disciples facing each other across a narrow moon bridge over black water, sword aura hovering but not striking, clouds splitting the moon into bright and shadowed halves, tense restraint and the need for clarity.

07.name: The Army
07.description: A disciplined formation of armored cultivators moving through bamboo at dawn, led by a calm general with a bronze lantern and silent command banner, loyalty and shared purpose without aggression.

08.name: Holding Together
08.description: Disciples from several sects gathered around a still moonlit pool where mountain streams meet, their reflections forming one quiet circle of blue-gold qi, belonging, sincerity, and mutual support.

09.name: Small Taming
09.description: A nimble wind cultivator carefully guiding a fluttering silk ribbon of qi between two fingers, thunderclouds gathering above a tiled pavilion but not yet breaking, small restraint shaping restless power.

10.name: Treading
10.description: A composed wandering swordswoman stepping lightly past the tail of a sleeping white tiger mountain guardian, moonlit grass bending beneath careful boots, danger met with grace, manners, and inner discipline.

11.name: Peace
11.description: A white-robed immortal and a dark-robed fox spirit resting together beneath blooming plum branches between descending moonlight and rising lantern warmth, heaven and earth breathing in harmony.

12.name: Standstill
12.description: A lone palace exile seated before a sealed vermilion gate in winter fog, dim lanterns hidden behind the wall, snow settling on bronze door rings, preservation and the wisdom of not forcing entry.

13.name: Fellowship
13.description: Wandering cultivators from different rooftops and sect banners meeting beneath a wide clear sky, lanterns shared along an ancient city lane, kinship beyond territory and common purpose in the jianghu.

14.name: Great Possession
14.description: A golden-eyed noble cultivator seated beside a jade treasure bowl filled with moonlit rice, bronze coins, seeds, bells, and glowing spirit pearls, abundance held with dignity and responsibility.

15.name: Modesty
15.description: A humble mountain monk sweeping fallen gingko leaves from a small cliffside shrine at dawn, plain robe, clean stones, mist, and a low bow of quiet competence, strength hidden in simplicity.

16.name: Enthusiasm
16.description: Young disciples preparing a lantern festival courtyard before summer thunder, silk ribbons lifting in charged wind, drum shadows waiting under red lanterns, energy gathering before the first beat.

17.name: Following
17.description: A traveling cultivator walking beside a winding river at dusk, following floating sky lanterns around each bend instead of forcing a straight path, a sheathed sword drifting at their side, trust in movement and response.

18.name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
18.description: A determined repairer-disciple restoring an old sect gate overgrown with vines, dusty footprints, simple tools, gold motes around rotting wood, ancestral neglect becoming care.

19.name: Approach
19.description: A wise elder immortal descending jade temple steps toward a younger disciple waiting below, spring mist lifting from the valley, lanterns brightening one by one, benevolent guidance arriving openly.

20.name: Contemplation
20.description: A contemplative scholar-cultivator seated on a high tiled roof at sunset, watching pavilions, bridges, riverboats, courtyards, and clouds arrange themselves into one living pattern below, quiet observation from above.

21.name: Biting Through
21.description: A sharp-eyed magistrate cultivator cutting through a black knotted cord across a moon gate, gold qi sparks breaking from the obstruction, decisive justice and a blocked path opened.

22.name: Grace
22.description: A graceful palace performer beneath peach blossoms beside a lacquered lantern and folded silk fan, beauty simple and restrained, moonlight revealing elegance without vanity.

23.name: Splitting Apart
23.description: A weary swordsman perched on a weathered cliffside pavilion as old roof tiles loosen and fall into a foggy ravine, the structure thinning beneath a cold moon, release and caution at the edge.

24.name: Return
24.description: A young cultivator following their own footprints through fresh snow toward a warm cave shrine, the first green sprout glowing beside the path, renewal after stillness and a cycle beginning again.

25.name: Innocence
25.description: A barefoot wandering youth leaping through tall grass beneath a suddenly clear sky, only natural movement and bright wind qi, sincerity without agenda.

26.name: Great Taming
26.description: A strong guardian cultivator seated before a mountain archive of scrolls, seeds, bells, and sealed jade cases, a vast flying sword resting still above the roof, great energy held in discipline.

27.name: Nourishment
27.description: A temple cook-immortal beside a humble kitchen hearth watching steam rise from a rice bowl, herbs and dried tangerine peel hanging from beams, sacred attention to what is taken in and offered out.

28.name: Great Preponderance
28.description: A lone sword master crossing a sagging wooden beam above floodwater, heavy blossoms bending a branch overhead, sword aura balancing beneath their boots, too much weight requiring extraordinary poise.

29.name: The Abyss
29.description: A black-robed cultivator moving along wet stones inside a moonlit ravine, water rushing on both sides, blue qi tracing each careful step, repeated danger navigated through calm attention.

30.name: Radiance
30.description: Twin lantern guardians sitting beside palace lamps during a rainy evening, reflections glowing in dark window glass and puddled stone, clarity, attachment, and warmth illuminating ordinary things.

31.name: Influence
31.description: A fox spirit and a young swordsman quietly noticing each other across a moonlit scholar garden, one sleeve disturbing a lotus pond as the ripple reaches the far shore, gentle attraction and mutual response.

32.name: Duration
32.description: An old master and a young disciple walking the same stone path through changing seasons shown in drifting petals, rain, leaves, and snow, steadiness through time.

33.name: Retreat
33.description: A wounded martial artist slipping quietly into mountain bamboo as dawn light rises behind pursuing shadows, cloak disappearing into mist, withdrawal as wisdom, dignity, and self-preservation.

34.name: Great Power
34.description: A thunder cultivator standing in a wind-torn field holding a kite string charged with storm qi, thunderheads gathering over distant pavilions, strength guided by restraint, power that must not become force.

35.name: Progress
35.description: A bright young court cultivator climbing sunlit imperial academy steps at morning, banners stirring gently, the city below waking through golden mist, recognition and forward movement with humility.

36.name: Darkening of the Light
36.description: A luminous-eyed fugitive immortal hiding their glow beneath a woven bamboo basket during a harsh night patrol, armored shadows passing beyond paper screens, inner light protected until danger passes.

37.name: The Family
37.description: A cultivation household gathered in a warm courtyard kitchen, elders, children, bowls, herbs, folded cloth, lanterns, and family tablets implied without readable marks, ordered harmony, care, roles, and belonging.

38.name: Opposition
38.description: Two rival cultivators on opposite sides of a rooftop ridge at sunset, one in warm gold light and one in blue shadow, different sect colors, both held by the same vast sky, difference without exile.

39.name: Obstruction
39.description: A traveling alchemist paused before a flooded mountain path blocked by fallen pine branches and broken stone, noticing a small side trail glowing through fog, difficulty redirecting attention.

40.name: Deliverance
40.description: A freed disciple shaking rain from a soaked cloak as storm clouds break over a mountain village, loose binding cords falling away from a gate, blue sky opening through torn cloud, release after tension.

41.name: Decrease
41.description: A quiet shrine attendant placing one bronze coin, one rice grain, and one flower petal into a small offering bowl before a mountain altar, less becoming meaningful, simplification and sincerity.

42.name: Increase
42.description: A river goddess and a young farmer-cultivator planting seeds beside a riverbank as spring wind scatters golden leaves upstream and downstream, green qi spreading from the soil, generosity multiplying through motion.

43.name: Breakthrough
43.description: A resolute sword cultivator standing on a rooftop at dawn as a torn storm cloud opens into clear light, a flying sword at rest and truth announced without cruelty.

44.name: Coming to Meet
44.description: A wandering cultivator encountering a sudden nine-tailed foxfire glow at a crossroads beneath willow branches, beautiful, magnetic, and potentially disruptive, discernment before fascination.

45.name: Gathering Together
45.description: Many cultivators, villagers, and spirit companions assembling in a lantern-lit ancestral courtyard around a central drum and offering table, memory, community, and shared focus gathering energy.

46.name: Pushing Upward
46.description: A young disciple carrying a tiny sapling up moss-covered stone steps toward sunrise, cloud terraces rising above them one by one, patient ascent, steady effort, and growth that cannot be rushed.

47.name: Oppression
47.description: A tired cultivator at the bottom of a dry stone well looking up at a circle of stars, empty bucket, worn walls, and one faint spirit lantern, limitation revealing inner endurance.

48.name: The Well
48.description: Villagers, disciples, and a small moonlit spirit animal gathered around an ancient stone well beneath cedar and pine, water reflecting the moon and a ring of soft qi without being owned, shared nourishment and timeless source.

49.name: Revolution
49.description: A rebel princess shedding an old patterned collar and court cloak beside a firelit dye vat, autumn leaves swirling like banners and red-gold qi rising from the steam, transformation at the proper time.

50.name: The Cauldron
50.description: An alchemist cultivator watching a bronze ding cauldron steam in a temple kitchen, herbs, sparks, and moonlit incense rising together, refinement, culture, and transformation through care.

51.name: The Arousing
51.description: A startled young disciple leaping as thunder cracks above a mountain gate, lanterns trembling but not falling, lightning qi illuminating rain and stone, shock awakening attention and life force.

52.name: Keeping Still
52.description: A meditating immortal sitting motionless on a high mountain stone, long sleeves and hair still while mist and cloud rivers move around them, stillness as strength.

53.name: Development
53.description: A traveling scholar and white crane spirit crossing a series of stepping stones through a twilight marsh, distant painted screens and cloud towers beyond, each careful step part of a long migration, gradual progress.

54.name: The Marrying Maiden
54.description: A young noblewoman entering a lantern-lit household garden at dusk, half welcomed and half uncertain beneath red silk and moon gates, delicate social timing, position, and adaptation.

55.name: Abundance
55.description: A charismatic festival host beneath a canopy of lanterns, peonies, and summer banners, dancers and spirit lights nearby, everything bright, full, and briefly at its height, abundance with awareness of passing time.

56.name: The Wanderer
56.description: A traveling swordsman carrying a small cloth bundle and sheathed short sword along a mountain road at sunset, distant inn lights below the cliff, beauty and loneliness of temporary shelter.

57.name: The Gentle
57.description: A soft-spoken wind adept moving silently through tall bamboo as every stalk bends, pale green qi slipping between leaves, influence entering gradually and persistence without force.

58.name: Joy
58.description: Two young cultivators beside a moonlit lake, one hand touching the water while small bronze bells ring in a breeze, shared delight, openness, and gentle communication.

59.name: Dispersion
59.description: A river spirit watching fog lift from a wide river as paper lanterns drift apart and rejoin the current, old hardness dissolving into movement and breath.

60.name: Limitation
60.description: A disciplined water cultivator arranging bamboo water cups along a garden channel, each cup filling only to its proper measure before tipping onward, boundaries, rhythm, and useful restraint.

61.name: Inner Truth
61.description: A gentle oracle resting beside an open birdcage under the moon, no chase, only trust and quiet listening, a soft golden glow at the heart and a feather drifting free.

62.name: Small Preponderance
62.description: A careful palace attendant balancing tiny porcelain tea cups on a narrow shelf in a wind-bright pavilion, every sleeve movement precise, modest attention making small things matter greatly.

63.name: After Completion
63.description: A seasoned cultivator crossing the final stone of a stream at dusk, looking back at perfectly placed footprints as a lantern steadies and water settles, completion that still requires vigilance.

64.name: Before Completion
64.description: A young fox-spirit traveler paused before the last step across a dawn stream, one foot lifted, mist glowing on the far bank, the crossing almost complete but not yet secured.
